item.title: How Much New AI Compute Comes Online in 2027? Backing It Out from NVIDIA's Revenue
item.description: About 15 GW of new NVIDIA compute (IT basis, range 13–18 GW; about 18 GW grid-side) powers on in 2027, equal to about 23 GW of GB200 or 20 GW of GB300. Derived from NVIDIA's revenue and revenue per GW, cross-checked against TSMC capacity, the supply chain and analyst forecasts.
